decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler is a core-adjacent product in a growing market and fits the firm's efficiency focus, so dropping it after one year is unlikely.
The air cooled condenser fits the established portfolio and serves energy and process customers, though its overlap with Product C carries some consolidation risk.
This is a second single-tube condenser variant, so it is somewhat more likely to be merged or relabeled, but it still sits close to the core business.
The tube liner for corroded heat exchangers supports the firm's lifecycle service strategy and recurring repair revenue.
Customized industrial air coolers match the firm's integrated-solutions positioning and depend on its existing engineering capability.
Tube end repair inserts are a low-cost service product that strengthens aftermarket business with the installed base.
